title: Installing Prisma in Next.js
description: Install and initialize Prisma in both Next.js App Router and Pages Router projects.

data.text: Prisma works seamlessly with Next.js in both the App Router and Pages Router. The installation steps are the same, but where you access the database differs slightly.

items: **App Router** — Access Prisma in Server Components, Server Actions, and Route Handlers
**Pages Router** — Access Prisma in `getServerSideProps`, API routes, and server-side code

data.title: Package Installation
data.content: Install Prisma packages using your preferred package manager.
data.code:
npm install prisma @prisma/client --save-dev

# Or with Yarn
yarn add prisma @prisma/client --dev

# Or with pnpm
pnpm add prisma @prisma/client --save-dev

data.title: Tip
data.text: In the App Router, Prisma Client should only be imported in server-side code (Server Components, Server Actions, Route Handlers). Never import it in client components.
